product.olivetti-netstrada-7600.summary: The Xeon NetStrada the City of Pisa used for document management.
product.olivetti-netstrada-7600.history: The City of Pisa's equipment lease identifies two NetStrada 7600 systems for its document management service, one primary and one backup.
product.olivetti-netstrada-7600.architec: Pisa used a single-processor configuration. The contract specifies a 700 MHz Pentium III Xeon, 2 MB of cache, 1 GB of RAM and Ultra Wide SCSI RAID 5.
product.olivetti-netstrada-7600.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-netstrada-7600.limitati: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
